text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] spike: api-gateway-us-east sending repeated heartbeat-style requests to auth-service (src=10.20.30.40) - rate 8k/min. auto-escalation -> incidents channel

maria: I'm seeing identical X-Heartbeat headers and an x-api-key header pattern. tagging @ajit oncall.

ajit: oncall here, looking. can someone paste a raw sample?

lane: copying a single sample from the edge logs:```[2026-03-20T20:12:01Z] GET /v1/health 200 12ms host=api-gateway-us-east src=10.20.30.40 headers={"X-Heartbeat":"1","x-api-key":"sk_live_Abc123..."}```

maria: thanks. that x-api-key looks like a live key pattern. I'm eyeballing S3 debug-uploads and saw a recent shard in staging buckets with entries referencing the same key id. not yet public, but it's in a debug rollup.

security: create an incident ticket and run quick scan across log buckets. I spun up INC-2026-042. priorities: 1) stop ongoing traffic 2) scope exposed artifacts 3) rotate compromised creds 4) customer impact assessment.

pagerbot: Incident created: INC-2026-042. Pager duty: oncall ajit.

ajit: taking immediate actions: blocking src 10.20.30.40 at WAF, adding temporary rule to reject requests with header X-Heartbeat, and flagging the API key for rotation. executing:```aws wafv2 update-ip-set --addresses 10.20.30.40/32 --name apigw-blacklist```

maria: copying the S3 object paths I found:
- s3://redwood-staging-logs/api-gw/2026/03/20/debug-rollup-20260320-20.log
- s3://redwood-staging-logs/api-gw/2026/03/20/session-snippet-45.json

security: good catch. are those buckets public-read?

maria: no, internal-only, but lifecycle pushed one rollup to an intermediate staging area yesterday for diagnostics (shouldn't have contained live keys).

support_lead: heads-up — if those are live keys, we need to prepare a low-level customer notification template. holding until rotation confirmation.

ajit: running a grep for the key id across all S3 prefixes now. quick result: matched in two staging rollups and one ephemeral debug archive that was TTL'd but still present in /tmp on a ci-runner.

lane: CI runner path: /var/tmp/ci-artifacts/runner-77/debug-archive.tar.gz - I can SSH and clear the file if we want.

ajit: please clear and quarantine that runner snapshot. also enumerating all tokens with pattern sk_live_* and queuing rotation.

security: rotate plan: 1) revoke the key immediately in KMS/credentials store 2) issue new key with restricted scopes 3) invalidate any cached sessions referencing it 4) run an audit for read access to S3 staging buckets in last 72h. I'll own revocation.

maria: quick on-the-wire mitigation done: WAF block + header drop. traffic from 10.20.30.40 dropped. still seeing a tail of retries from other ips — likely distributed probes. blocking observed ASN ranges now.

ajit: revocation API call executed:```POST /internal/keys/revoke {"key_id":"sk_live_Abc123"}``` response 200. Generating replacement key and kicking rolling deploy to services that use it.

support_lead: pinging CSMs for any customers on impacted routes. initial check: no elevated error rates in customer telemetry. marking customer_impact: low/unknown until we confirm token misuse.

lane: cleaned the CI runner file and rotated the runner's ephemeral credentials. also triggered a temporary deny policy on the staging bucket so only security-admin role can read.

security: audit results: three identities (svc-ci, dev-ops-diagnostic, thirdparty-logger) read those staging objects in last 48h. we need to rotate any creds for thirdparty-logger and request their attest.

maria: assembling short timeline for postmortem: first spike at 20:11:59Z, staging rollup created at 20:09Z, CI run at 19:58Z (attached artifact).

ajit: handoff: my shift ends in 30m. I'll leave follow-ups: confirm thirdparty rotation, update incident ticket with revocation IDs, and keep WAF block. @lane or @maria please take on overnight monitor.

maria: taking overnight monitor. I'll run an hourly check on WAF hits and S3 access logs, and I'll collate a draft customer note if we find evidence of exfil.

support_lead: I'll draft a holding customer message now (internal review) in case we need to notify.

security: next steps checklist posted to INC-2026-042. tagging playbook: https://confluence.internal/redwood/playbooks/keys-and-logs-exposure 

ajit: thanks team — leaving notes in the ticket. handing to maria for overnight. :thumbsup:

maria: acknowledged. will post a status update every hour or on any material change.

pagerbot: :white_check_mark: incident status: mitigating -> monitoring.
